correctness.rationale: On every prefix tree, basic open cones give the infinite-descendant test. Finite pigeonholing constructs an infinite chain of Omega(A) nodes for finitely branching T; infinitely many immediate children yield a counterexample with finite Omega(A). The recursive well-founded witness B_alpha has its root through precisely alpha and children vanished by alpha; disjoint cone locality verifies the induction at successors and limits. The spine is a permanent Omega fixed point, with cofinal side branches vanishing at any prescribed countable limit. Countability of the carrier excludes noncountable first-stabilization ordinals. Verified definitions and boundary cases; finite examples are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The iff idempotence condition is an exact structural boundary for modal-depth collapse under every valuation, and the contrasting complete ordinal spectrum is realized within one countable non-T1 prefix space. This is a naturally motivated classification of omega-accumulation dynamics, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice or a trivial reproduction of the general decomposition. The proof identifies a sharp transition between finite-branching persistent paths and infinite fan pruning.
